title: Embedded dashboard declaration (fabric-dashboard/0.1, DEC-0036)
description: The value a service puts under the extension key https://fabric.passioncode.ai/agent-contract/extensions/dashboard/0.1 in its well-known document's extensions (ED-9): the page's floor width, the appearance fields it applies, the themes it ships and the kit it is built from. A host validates the value against this schema and treats an invalid one as not declared (ED-9, DEC-0059); a checker reports it as FAC-SEM-080.

minWidth.description: The page's floor in CSS pixels (ED-1). A host gives the page at least max(480, minWidth) (ED-7).

appearance.description: The fabric_appearance cookie fields the page applies, and only these (ED-6, ED-8, DEC-0059). A field not listed stays the page's own; with none listed, the page takes nothing from the cookie and follows prefers-color-scheme only.

themes.description: Theme ids the page ships (ED-10). The reference set is graphite, fabric, paper, forest, ocean, ember, contrast; other ids are free.

kit.description: The dashboard kit the page is built from, name@semver.
